title: explorer.signal.v1
description: A real-time news/signal record (injury, transfer, sentiment, market-moving headline) captured by a Mission Center realtime pipeline — NOT match/odds/context data (that is Sport Hub's canonical stream). Persisted to the signals/ lake layer and, best-effort, published to Atlas via a Redis stream (see explorer/realtime/publisher.py).

signal_type.description: What kind of signal this is. Additive-only.

source_id.description: The explorer.realtime.signal_source.v1 record (SignalSource) that captured this.

entity_refs.description: Entities this signal concerns — club/player/competition — best-effort resolved, never fabricated.

club_id.description: Resolved via the Club Registry when possible.

published_at.description: When the source published this (RFC3339 UTC).

captured_at.description: When Explorer's collector captured it (RFC3339 UTC).
